L.P mazot pump, which must be performed bases on an annually as indicated by Y1 in the

and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out
Removal of the pump with pumps gearbox

Check the closing of the suction, delivery. Heating steam, and condensate
valve.

Prepare a tank for catching liquid from disconnected piping and from the
pump at which drain plug is screwed off.
Disconnect suction and delivery piping from the pump.
Screw off the nuts of the coupling bolts.
Screw of the bolts (30) between the pump brackets and foundation.
Lifting the pump with pumps gearbox to the maintenance workshop.

pump at which drain plug is screwed off.

Screw off the nuts of the coupling bolts.
Screw of the bolts (30) between the pump brackets and foundation.
Lifting the pump with pumps gearbox to the maintenance workshop.

sections.text: Disassembly of the pump

Remove the coupling from the shaft of the pumps gearbox by using
suitable puller and take out key (17).
Screw off nuts (31) to remove pump cover (26) from the pump body (20).
Screw off nuts (24) of the rotating pistons.
Screw off the nuts of gland flange (29).

Screw off nuts of the bolts (32) which connected hydraulic part of the
pump with pumps gearbox.
Pull the hydraulic part with rotating pistons along the two shafts.

sections.text: Inspection of the pump parts

Check the rotating piston (23) from mechanical wear and renewed if it
need.

Check the pumps cover (26) and hydraulic part (20) from the mechanical
wear and repair or renewed if it need.
Check the fixation of the stuffing box to the hydraulic part.
Check the gasket (25) and renewed if it need
Chang the gland packing with the suitable size.

sections.text: Disassembly of the pumps gear box
Drain the lubricating oil from the gearbox by screw of plug (33).

Screw off nuts (35) to remove gearbox cover (14) and take out oil seal
(13).
Screw off the nuts (12) from the two shafts of the gearbox (2)&(3).
Pullouts ring (16) and remove oil seal (15).
Pullout the gearwheel (10) and gearwheel with bevel (8)&(9).
Take out the supporting ring (7) from shafts (2)&(3).

Hammering on the shaft (3) of gearbox but it must be put a wooden piece
between the hammer and the shaft.
Take out the driver and driven shaft of the gearbox.
Pullout the inner race of the bearing (6) from shafts.
Take out the distance pipe (5).
Pullout the bearing (4).

Remove the outer race of the bearing (6) from the bearing house of the
gearbox.

Check the oil seal (13&15)) and renewed if it needed.

Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly.

Installing the pump with the pumps gear box to the 
foundation
Install the pump in reverse sequence of the removal sequence.

sections.text:
Re. Alignment According to the 
MPIS doc # cpl-001-r0
Change the packing of the stuffing box
Clean the surfaces of the stuffing box and shaft well.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of shaft with the same diameter of the 
pump shaft

The number of turns is equal to the numbers of rings needed in the
stuffing box.
Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using a sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box with the cut turned 180o,
starting at 9 clock.
The packing should never be knocked as they then may become damaged.

Remember that in a stuffing box there must always be as light leakage of
the fluid.

Do not tighten the gland hard to prevent the rise in temperature of the
stuffing box.

sections.text: Refilling the pumps gear box by lubricating oil
Prepare the suitable lubricating oil in a clean bottle.
Open the plug (34) and close plug (33).

Fill some lubricating oil and turn the gearbox by hand many times to
clean gearbox.
Open the plug (33) and drain the oil, which used to clean.

Close the plug (33) again and open plug (34) and then filling the gearbox
with oil until 2/3 of oil side glass.
